info.name: MS365 Sync
info.summary: Sync Microsoft 365 OneDrive and SharePoint libraries to Nextcloud
info.description:
Connect your Microsoft 365 tenant and sync OneDrive and SharePoint document libraries to Nextcloud.
Features: - Connect via Azure App Registration - Browse OneDrive and SharePoint document libraries - Configure sync jobs to copy libraries into Nextcloud - Resilient transfers via rclone (handles 100GB+ overnight) - Pause, resume, and schedule sync jobs - View rclone transfer logs
info.author: haraldo
